title: THE SINKHOLE · The fold
venue: The Unprinted · a Sunday page from a paper he never drew for, found in Box 5 in the private years
logline: The found Sunday's fourth page is the fold itself: the newsprint's crease running through the page, and on either side of it two different drawings — the river town's landing on the left, the Alsea boat launch on the right — meeting at the crease as one street. Wood's margin note in pencil, the only thing on the page in his hand: 'not mine. keep.'

panels.composition: A full page bisected by a drawn newsprint crease: on the left a river town's landing with a boat, on the right a coastal boat launch with a chimney across a bay, the two meeting at the crease as a single continuous street; a pencilled note in the bottom margin in a different hand.
